title: CB3D17 post-buckling / snap-through: FEM spherical arc-length vs ANSYS 18.0 LINK180 + ARCLEN
description: FEM-Eigen stability_path_3d.hpp implements a Crisfield spherical arc-length path follower (load factor lambda as an unknown, consistent tangent reused from fem_3d_nl.hpp co-rotational elements, quadratic constraint with correct-root selection). ANSYS 18.0 uses LINK180 with KEYOPT(2)=1 (logarithmic strain), NLGEOM,ON, ARCLEN,ON and ARCTRM,U; per-substep apex UY and support FY reactions are written to CSV. The von Mises two-bar shallow truss has an independent analytic equilibrium path P(v)=-2*N*(h-v)/L with N=EA*ln(L/L0) for the log strain measure and N=EA*(L-L0)/L0 for the FEM kernel engineering strain. The path passes the limit point, the descending branch, lambda=0 at v=h, negative loads, and lambda=0 again at v=2h. KEYOPT(2)=0 is archived as a strain-measure contrast only.
